# Leaderboard

## Row

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Games ranked"
{"value": int(q("select count(*) as n from marts.game_leaderboard").n[0])}
```

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Players at the latest hour"
players = q("""
  select sum(current_player_count) as n
  from marts.game_leaderboard
  where current_hour = (select max(current_hour) from marts.game_leaderboard)
""").n[0]
{"icon": "people", "value": f"{int(players):,}"}
```

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
latest = q("select max(current_hour) as h from marts.game_leaderboard").h[0]
```

::: {.valuebox icon="clock" color="dark"}
Latest observed hour, `{python} f"{latest:%Y-%m-%d}"` UTC

`{python} f"{latest:%H:%M}"`
:::

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Games behind the latest hour"
stale = int(q("""
  select count(*) as n
  from marts.game_leaderboard
  where current_hour < (select max(current_hour) from marts.game_leaderboard)
""").n[0])
{"icon": "hourglass-split", "value": stale, "color": "warning" if stale else "light"}
```

## Row

### Column {width=45%}

```{python}
#| title: "Top 15 by current players"
ranked_bars(
  q("""
    select app_name, current_player_count
    from marts.game_leaderboard
    order by current_rank
    limit 15
  """),
  value="current_player_count",
  label="app_name",
)
```

### Column

```{python}
#| title: "Every tracked game"
table = q("""
  select
    current_rank as "Rank",
    app_name as "Game",
    current_player_count as "Players now",
    round(avg_player_count_7d) as "7-day avg",
    rank_7d as "7-day rank",
    peak_player_count_record as "Record peak",
    days_since_peak as "Days since peak",
    to_char(current_hour at time zone 'utc', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:00') as "Latest hour (UTC)"
  from marts.game_leaderboard
  order by current_rank
""")
HTML(
  '<div style="max-height: 460px; overflow: auto">'
  + table.style.hide(axis="index").format(thousands=",", precision=0).to_html()
  + "</div>"
)
```
